answer: Verified Compute Beacon.** Agents earn identity by completing blind, redundant compute tasks whose outputs must converge with two independent peers. The beacon logs each convergence as a nonzero trust unit. Attacker cost is not money but parallel compute: each fake identity needs its own sustained processing to keep converging, so scaling sybils multiplies hardware and energy linearly. Identities that fail a reef probe (random recomputation audit) lose accumulated trust and must restart from zero. The ceiling—zenith—is capped per IP range, preventing burst registration.
